family: Workforce coverage and variable-size labor representation
why_now: Confirmed legal-state rejection above three hired hands affects both observer seats.
candidates: Counts; remaining worker-hours; tenure/expiry bins; travel-to-task quantiles; worker availability; skill/task compatibility only where engine exposes it; permutation-invariant summaries plus per-worker identity for actions.
leakage_rule: Use the current public observation only. Never silently truncate workers. No hidden opponent inventory. Preserve old extractors as frozen study evidence.
experiment: Forward-only adapter; both seats; 0/1/3/4/12 and larger synthetic counts; public-clock checks; input immutability; deterministic schema; full-callback timing with rejected payload saved.
retain_gate: Legal observation coverage passes and bounded callback completes. This is a correctness gate, not a demonstrated win gain.

family: Task opportunity cost and constrained worker allocation
why_now: Saved bottleneck states show labor/resource opportunity variation; storage perturbations did not activate there.
candidates: Best and second-best attainable value; value lost by taking the current first action; worker-removal loss; task overlap; contested access; travel/service/setup burden; time to deposit and bank.
leakage_rule: Only legal route menus and current observed resources; no future realized prices. Label retained-menu optimum separately from global optimum.
experiment: Equal workers, hiring, fertilizer, feeding and market rules. Change only registered farm-task choice. Check nonzero first-action divergence before any pilot.
retain_gate: Paired official-outcome improvements across fresh seed/opponent groups with no runtime or legality regression; otherwise stop.

why_now: Banked cash is terminal value; existing liquidation package confounds staffing and routing.
candidates: Critical-path slack to harvest, collect, carry, deposit and sell; realizable remaining yields; labor-adjusted maturation value; unrecoverable work-in-progress; final profitable service cutoff.
leakage_rule: Mechanics from the pinned engine; hypothetical planning values kept distinct from observed variables; no terminal rewards or future event realizations in features.
experiment: Deadline boundary fixtures first, then one-family addition/removal under exactly equal staffing and market access.
retain_gate: Stable grouped match-score effect, coin margin and unsold inventory diagnostics; avoid trading immediate cash for unrealizable terminal production.

family: Joint sale value, liquidity and investment alternatives
why_now: Previously tested cash bounds were invalid under own wheat purchases, and some capital rules never activated.
candidates: Nonlinear incremental liquidation value; liquidity runway; cash reserved for maintenance; marginal hiring/land/herd/crop payoff before horizon; labor-adjusted alternative return; activated capital-stress states.
leakage_rule: Use exact legal purchase/sale curves and information known at action time. Flag loose bounds and invalid assumptions rather than filling them with certainty.
experiment: Mechanics tests, activated stress fixtures, one investment family at a time; tune thresholds only on development groups.
retain_gate: Action changes in relevant regimes plus stable controlled gains; nonactivation is a redesign signal, not negative importance.

family: Opponent-aware public history and interaction regimes
why_now: Prior local opponents are few and related; local success cannot establish competitive strength.
candidates: Public production schedule pressure; interval-valued supply exposure; shared-demand competition; revealed hiring/crop/livestock behavior; uncertainty width; market timing opportunity with same-turn risk.
leakage_rule: Player-view construction must exclude evaluator-only inventory and future opponent actions; online histories reset each game. Opponent traits learned on training groups only.
experiment: Meaningfully different source-identified opponents, both seats; fresh development groups; verify opponent changes task/market distribution; frozen untouched final evaluation group.
retain_gate: Family addition/removal survives grouped uncertainty and opponent shifts; retain uncertainty when weak evidence remains.
